data.message: I commit to 18 tons: an individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k; stock left=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). All18 leaves50, then500 or100—not risk-free or guaranteed best long-run. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Will you opt in even if others choose10?
